text: I recommend Option D: "the same design three neighboring towns use." This decision prioritizes maintaining tradition while ensuring safety and functionality of the bridge. By reusing the existing design from nearby towns, we avoid costly modifications, reduce project time significantly (nine days vs. months for modern replacements), and minimize environmental impact compared to new construction. Additionally, this approach allows local expertise and materials to be leveraged without the need for extensive renovations or custom designs that might compromise original integrity. The community can appreciate the heritage value alongside improved accessibility, making this an optimal choice based on cost-effectiveness, timeline efficiency, and preservation goals.
